title: Plucking grain on the Sabbath
author: Hajime Murai
note: 2022 downloadable source snapshot. Relationship labels are source data; explanation wording is ChiFold editorial. Source Bible quotations are excluded. Subverse elements show whole verses as context.

nodes.label: C
nodes.title:
Exceptions provisions of the priest.
The first correspondence is about the sabbathe and Jesus. The second correspondence is about discussion related to sin. The central correspondence is about exception for the priest at the temple. The latter half is composed of objection against the Pharisees. This structure indicates the innocence of the disciples and also emphasizes the metaphor which allegorizes Jesus as the temple. 12:7 includes citation of Hosea 6:6
